Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

def uleb(n):
    out=[]
    while True:
        b=n&0x7f; n >>=7
        if n: out.append(b|0x80)
        else: out.append(b); break
    return bytes(out)
def sec(id,body): return bytes([id])+uleb(len(body))+body
def func_type(params,results): return b'\x60'+uleb(len(params))+bytes(params)+uleb(len(results))+bytes(results)
def wasm(codes, types, func_types, exports=None):
    data=b'\0asm\1\0\0\0'
    data+=sec(1, uleb(len(types))+b''.join(types))
    data+=sec(3, uleb(len(func_types))+b''.join(uleb(x) for x in func_types))
    if exports:
        body=uleb(len(exports))
        for name,kind,idx in exports:
            body+=uleb(len(name))+name.encode()+bytes([kind])+uleb(idx)
        data+=sec(7,body)
    body=uleb(len(codes))
    for locals_body, code in codes:
        fb=locals_body+code
        body+=uleb(len(fb))+fb
    data+=sec(10, body)
    return data
I32=0x7f; I64=0x7e; F32=0x7d; F64=0x7c; VOID=0x40
# candidate: type0 func, type1 block param+results? (param i32 i32 result i32 i32)
types=[func_type([],[]), func_type([I32,I32],[I32,I32])]
# code: i32.const 0; i32.const 1; i32.const 1; if typeidx 1; unreachable; else; end; drop; drop; end
code= b'\x41\x00\x41\x01\x41\x01\x04' + uleb(1) + b'\x00\x05\x0b\x1a\x1a\x0b'
# Actually typeidx block type signed LEB 1 same uleb
w=wasm([(b'\x00', code)], types, [0], [('main',0,0)])
Path('/workspace/cand_if_param.wasm').write_bytes(w)
print(len(w), w.hex())
